subject: AcmeCloud MSA + Order Form: new subprocessor (LogStream) & DPA addendum request
messages:
From: Jessica Hammond <jessica.hammond@acmecloud.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@globex.com, legal@acmecloud.ai
Date: Thu, 23 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New subprocessor notice + redlines (MSA/Order Form)

Hi Kim —

Thanks for the time last week. Per our procurement intake, attaching a redlined MSA and the corresponding Order Form. We have a new downstream subprocessor (LogStream, a managed log aggregation provider) that will receive limited logs for debugging/observability.

What we need from Redwood:
- Confirmation that the proposed subprocessor flow-down language in the redline is acceptable, or a tracked alternative.
- An executed DPA addendum covering LogStream’s role and the security controls (we attached the requested Subprocessor_Summary.xlsx).
- Any procurement paperwork (PO or order flow) we should route to your billing team.

Target timeline: we are hoping to close commercial terms and counter-sign within 5 business days (COB Oct 30). If you need a longer review window, please let us know expected ETA and any required evidence.

Attachments: AcmeCloud_MSA_redline_v3.pdf; OrderForm-ACME-2025-10-22.docx; Subprocessor_Summary.xlsx

Thanks — looking forward to a quick turnaround.

Best,
Jessica Hammond
Sr. Contracts Manager | AcmeCloud
jessica.hammond@acmecloud.ai
+1 415-555-0182

On Thu, Oct 23, 2025 at 09:12 AM Jessica Hammond <jessica.hammond@acmecloud.ai> wrote:
> Kim — sending the redlines per our conversation. Please confirm receipt.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Hammond <jessica.hammond@acmecloud.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 23 Oct 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New subprocessor notice + redlines (MSA/Order Form)

Hi Jessica — thanks, got everything. Quick plan from our side:

1) Legal (looping Karthik) will review the MSA redline and the subprocessor clauses (specifically the flow-down wording in Section 5 and the Order Form annex). Expecting first pass by end-of-day tomorrow (Oct 24).
2) Procurement (Marissa) will validate the Order Form references and confirm whether a PO will be required and where to send invoicing.
3) We need evidence for LogStream: SOC2 (or equivalent), encryption at rest/transit description, and confirmation they are onboarding under their own DPA. Please confirm that Subprocessor_Summary.xlsx is the latest snapshot.

A few immediate asks for clarity so we can be decisive:
- Is LogStream going to have any access to customer PII? (yes/no + short note)
- Will LogStream persist logs beyond 30 days?
- Any planned cross-border transfers (EU→US) for these logs?

If Legal requests redline changes that affect commercial terms significantly, we’ll flag for escalation to your procurement team by Oct 27. Otherwise, we aim to provide a counter-redline or sign-off by Oct 24 EOD.

I’ve attached a short internal checklist (see attachments) — we’ll share the legal comments in a tracked PDF.

—Kim
Kimberly Park
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Jessica Hammond <jessica.hammond@acmecloud.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 24 Oct 2025 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New subprocessor notice + redlines (MSA/Order Form)

Kim / Jessica — taking a look this morning. Initial procurement/legal triage:

- High-level: the proposed flow-down text on limiting onward transfers is acceptable in principle, but we need to tighten the audit and evidence obligations (we prefer "reasonable audit rights + SOC2 report delivery") rather than unlimited audit language.
- Clause 6.3 (indemnity carveouts) in the Order Form redline is a commercial risk; Marissa, please advise if Procurement can accept a cap tied to fees for this Order. If not, we will raise to commercial leadership.
- For LogStream evidence: if they can provide a current SOC2 report and an encryption matrix, we can proceed without escalation. If not, escalate.

Marissa: see inline comment below — confirm if PO or invoice flow is required. If PO, we need vendor W-9 and billing contacts.

I’ll compile legal comments and push a tracked-change PDF to the thread by COB today. If we need an exception to our standard DPA flow-down (e.g., special subprocessor annex), flag it and I’ll coordinate with the Privacy team.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Counsel, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

On Fri, Oct 24, 2025 at 09:22 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Quick triage notes above — attaching checklist we use for subprocessor additions (will upload a short summary).
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Jessica Hammond <jessica.hammond@acmecloud.ai>, legal@acmecloud.ai
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, procurement@globex.com
Date: Mon, 27 Oct 2025 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: New subprocessor notice + redlines (MSA/Order Form)

Hi Jessica / Acme legal — thanks for your patience. Status update and next steps:

1) What we can accept today (subject to evidence):
   - Flow-down language: we can agree to the proposed subprocessor flow-down with the edit that the buyer provide the subprocessor's SOC2 (or equivalent) within 5 business days of execution. We will replace unlimited audit language with delivery of the latest SOC2 and a right to review security controls at reasonable notice.
   - Order Form: commercially we accept the Order Form with a redline on Clause 6.3 to add a liability cap linked to the three-month committed fee.

2) Required deliverables before countersignature:
   - LogStream SOC2 or equivalent report (PDF)
   - Encryption matrix and data retention confirmation (no retention beyond 90 days without prior written approval)
   - Vendor W-9 and billing contact for PO/invoice flow
3) DocuSign & execution timeline:
   - We’ve initiated a DocuSign envelope for the Order Form + MSA annex: https://docusign.com/rdw-acme/ENVELOPE-2389. Please countersign or return by COB Oct 31 to meet your internal target. If the evidence items above are not complete by then, we will provisionally execute the Order Form under a contingent acceptance that suspends LogStream access until evidence is provided.

If any of the above is a blocker, let us know today so we can escalate internally. Once the DPA addendum for LogStream is executed, Redwood will mark the subprocessor in our registry and notify security & infra for onboarding.

Best,
Kim
Kimberly Park
Commercial Lead, Redwood Inference
